answer: The vine lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the tundra is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the delta of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, re-queued for a second panel. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
